name.ja: ＭＧ 1/100 MS-06FS ガルマ・ザビ専用 ザクＩＩ
name.en: MG 1/100 MS-06FS Garma Zabi exclusive Zaku II

description.ja: ガルマ特有なカラーリングにＭＳＶ特有のマーキングが施された高級感を漂わすガルマザク、遂にＭＧでキット化！！
description.en: Garuma Zaku, which has a luxurious feel with Garma's unique coloring and MSV's unique markings, is finally available as a kit in MG! !
Colonel Garma Zabi appears with Takagami --------------------

description.ja: 機動戦士ガンダム ＭＳＶより、ＭＳ－０６ＦＳ ガルマ・ザビ専用ザクIIを 1/100スケールＭＧシリーズで商品化。
description.en: From Mobile Suit Gundam MSV, the MS-06FS Garma Zabi Zaku II is commercialized in the 1/100 Scale MG series.

description.ja: 特徴的な頭部形状を新規パーツで再現し、印象的なカラーリングは成形色で再現。
description.en: The characteristic head shape is reproduced with new parts, and the impressive coloring is reproduced with molded colors.

description.ja: 専用のヒート・ホークも新規造形で付属！！
description.en: A special Heat Hawk is also included with a new model! !

description.ja: ● バルカン砲を４門備えた特徴的な頭部の形状を 新規パーツで再現！
description.en: ● The characteristic head shape with four Vulcan cannons is reproduced with new parts!

description.ja: ● 専用ヒート・ホーク を新規造形で再現！ ２色の成形色で色分け再現。
description.en: ● Reproduce the special Heat Hawk with new modeling! Color-coded reproduction with two molding colors.

description.ja: ● ＭＳＶ機体独特なラインなどのマークを含んだ水転写デカールが付属！
description.en: ● A water slide decal containing marks such as lines unique to the MSV aircraft is included!

description.ja: ● ポージングの幅が広がる豊富な武器付属
description.en: ● Comes with a variety of weapons that expand the range of poses

description.ja: 付属武装 ： 専用ヒート・ホーク ／ ヒート・ホーク ／ ザク・バズーカ ／ 175mmタンクガン ／
description.en: Attached weapons: Special Heat Hawk / Heat Hawk / Zaku Bazooka / 175mm tank gun /

description.ja: ザク・マシンガン ／ シュツルム・ファウスト
description.en: Zaku Machine Gun / Sturm Faust
